cover_dek: Hopes of peace between the US and Iran eased fears over oil prices.
big_headline: Oil fell 8% on Monday morning as talks in Qatar revived peace hopes.
big_body: Talks in Qatar revived hopes of reopening the Strait of Hormuz. President Donald Trump kept the threat of fresh strikes alive.
pol_body: Anthropic reported US$17 billion in third-quarter revenue, up from US$1.4 billion a year earlier. The company's computing commitments are approaching $900bn.
biz_body: Apple beat expectations on strong iPhone sales. Fourth-quarter sales reached $114.48-billion, above estimated $113.39-billion.
up_body: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 fall behind ahead of U.S. midterms and key earnings results.
